title: DOMO
tagline: Invest your cryptocurrencies in secure assets, generate monthly passive income, and participate in property value appreciation with Domo.
description: DOMO is a platform that aims to: enable the purchase and sale of real estate through blockchain technology, make real estate investment more accessible, transparent, facilitate the injection of resources into the real estate market, generate value reserves, and help crypto holders access a property and stabilize their portfolio.
how_its_made: we use Polygon, a specific Mumbai network, to create and manage our smart contracts. The contract addresses and information about the NFTs are stored in Polybase, which is a database that allows us to quickly access this information. For the front-end of our platform, we use various tools and technologies such as NextJS, Vercel, TailwindCSS, and Notion to create a user-friendly interface.
